target: credibility gates vs the production path after the PI decision of 2026-10-27 (gpufe/gate1*.py, gate2_fsu.py, results/gpufe_verify/*; methods/e02_friction_limit.py)
claim: Since 2026-10-27 the deciding slip-out number is mu_req computed by e02 from a TIED cage run, which for evo L1 / L1b means a GPU Newton run with tied contact. That whole chain can pass every existing gate and still give a wrong answer. (1) No gate exercises tied contact at all: no gate script contains 'tied', and gate 3 (tied cage vs FEBio) is 'pending'. (2) Of the gates, only 1d and gate 2 run the Newton solver. Gates 1b and 1c ran on 2026-10-26 on the old dynamic-relaxation solver (gate1b docstring line 1; gate1c imports solver, not newton). Gate 1d never leaves stick: min_stick_frac 1.0, max Fx/Fz 0.073, in all 3 passing cases. Gate 2 passed only flexion, with zero facet contact force on both facets (flex_pos_y.json facet_force_gpu_N 0.0 / 0.0), so contact under Newton has never been compared with anything. (3) e02 has been checked only on flat analytic discs (METHODS_COMPARISON.md:14). It was never tested on a case where the glue is in tension (F-0021, which would have been caught by a single glued block under a moment) or on a curved face (F-0011). (4) The PI made 'the law' the frictional reference instead of FEBio, but no gate states what the law predicts for a curved, cyclically loaded, partially slipping face, so gate 4 has no reference at all. (5) Gate reports carry no code version: flex_pos_y.json and gate1d_report.json have no git hash / dirty flag, while gpufe/contact.py and newton.py were being edited during this round (F-0025). A gate PASS therefore cannot be tied to the code that will produce design numbers.
evidence: grep -ln tied gpufe/gate*.py -> none. gpufe/gate1b_equilibrium.py:1 'GPU dynamic relaxation vs FEBio 4'; gate1c_friction.py:11 'import ... solver as slv' (no newton); git log: gate1c_report.json last committed 2026-10-26 11:10. gate1d_stick_memory.py:13,46 uses newton.NewtonSolver; results/gpufe_verify/gate1d/gate1d_report.json cases n 10/20/40: max_Fx_over_Fz 0.0727, min_stick_frac 1.0, passed true. results/gpufe_verify/gate2/flex_pos_y.json: facet_force_gpu_N {C34_L_FC: 0.0, C34_R_FC: 0.0}, PASS true; keys contain no git hash. VERIFICATION.md gate table: 3 'pending'. METHODS_COMPARISON.md:14 analytic checks = uniform disc only.
how_to_reproduce: grep -ln tied gpufe/gate*.py; python -c "import json; d=json.load(open('results/gpufe_verify/gate1d/gate1d_report.json')); print([(c['n'], c['legacy_rule'], c['max_Fx_over_Fz'], c['min_stick_frac']) for c in d['cases']])"; python -c "import json; d=json.load(open('results/gpufe_verify/gate2/flex_pos_y.json')); print(d['facet_force_gpu_N'], list(d))"

fix_options.option: Gate for the deciding chain before any design is ranked: (a) tied glued block under shear + moment, GPU tied vs FEBio tied, interface tractions and their tensile part; (b) e02 on analytic cases with tension (glued block under a moment: mu_req must use the net compression) and on a tilted / curved face with known answer; (c) gate 3 (p062 tied, GPU vs FEBio, e02 on both, < 10 %).

Rerun gates 1b / 1c with the Newton solver; gate 1c must reach gross slip and come back to stick (stick-slip-stick cycle, force control); gate 2 counts only if facet force > 0 and is compared with FEBio's facet force.
Every gate report stores git hash + dirty flag + sha256 of gpufe/*.py; the verifier rejects reports from a dirty tree.

summary_zh: PI 在 10 月 27 日決定：判斷滑出時先用計算（把 cage 黏死的模擬，再用 e02 算摩擦需求值）。這條計算路線目前可以通過所有驗證關卡，但結果仍然可能是錯的，因為關卡根本沒有測到它。第一，沒有任何一道關卡測試「黏死接觸」；負責比較 cage 黏死模型的第三關還沒做。第二，新的 GPU 牛頓法求解器只跑過兩道關卡：一道是摩擦測試，但物體從頭到尾都沒有滑動；另一道是正常脊椎節段比對，只通過前屈一個方向，而且小面關節的接觸力是零，等於接觸從來沒被測過。另外兩道關卡是用舊的求解器跑的。第三，e02 只在平面圓盤上檢查過，沒有測過黏膠受拉（見 F-0021，一個簡單的黏住方塊受彎矩的測試就能抓到）或曲面的情況。第四，PI 規定摩擦的參考是「物理定律」而不是 FEBio，但沒有任何關卡寫明在曲面、反覆受力、部分滑動時定律預測什麼。第五，關卡報告沒有記錄程式版本，而本輪期間求解器程式還在修改中。建議：在任何設計被排名之前，先加上黏死接觸與 e02 的關卡，用牛頓法重跑舊關卡，並在每份報告記錄程式版本。
